author: Czco
body:
This is addressed to a admin or higher.

Hello my name is coco_stag, my and my friend run a small server we have about 14 people on at a time.

We have skywars bewars and many others but not really enough people to play on them. We have some monthly payers on the server and a bit of cash. My suggestion is if we could use bungie and join our servers up, this will benefit u with players and money and us with the players as well, we have 2 owners Me and a player called DanManB or Stupus we can edit our staff and yours however you would like as long as me and danmanB can keep ours, the server is called stupus and the ip is (Retracted) we would love for this to happen and would bring us all together as a community.

lots of love Coco_stag

Our server ip : (Retracted)

Feel free to check us out
